features.name: fn.type_ec
features.description: 1 if the function is an EC number

features.name: fn.type_go
features.description: 1 if the function is a GO term

features.name: fn.type_other
features.description: 1 for any other function namespace (KEGG, COG, AMR, ...)

features.name: fn.go_aspect_mf
features.description: 1 if a GO claim is explicitly labelled MF

features.name: fn.go_aspect_bp

features.name: fn.go_aspect_cc
features.description: 1 if a GO claim is explicitly labelled CC

features.name: fn.go_aspect_unknown
features.description: 1 for GO claims with no aspect label (never assumed BP)

features.name: fn.in_complex_term
features.description: 1 if the GO term is a protein-complex term in state.complexClassification

features.name: fn.complex_heteromeric
features.description: 1 if that complex term is classified heteromeric (n)

features.name: fn.complex_ambiguous
features.description: 1 if that complex term is classified ambiguous (a): neither homomeric nor heteromeric is asserted

features.name: role.catalytic

features.name: role.accessory

features.name: role.unspecified
features.description: 1 if the candidate role is UNSPECIFIED; roles are distinct candidates

features.description: number of distinct sources reporting this function (not number of hits)

features.name: seq.n_groups_reporting
features.description: number of distinct evidence groups reporting this function

features.name: seq.max_raw_any
features.description: strongest raw score over all baseline sequence claims

features.name: seq.best_pident_available
features.description: 1 if any claim carries a percent-identity metadata value

features.name: seq.best_pident
features.description: best percent identity / 100 over claims carrying it (0 if unavailable)

features.name: seq.cov.status_available
features.description: 1 if predictor completion statuses were supplied

features.name: seq.cov.n_sources_not_fully_run
features.description: number of predictors with outcome FAILED, UNAVAILABLE or PARTIAL (absence from them is uninformative); 0 if statuses not supplied

features.name: seq.cov.n_sources_ran_clean
features.description: number of predictors with outcome SUCCESS or SUCCESS_ZERO; 0 if statuses not supplied

features.name: ctx.operon.available
features.description: 1 if operon calls were supplied (state.operons non-empty)

features.name: ctx.operon.member
features.description: 1 if the protein is in a called operon

features.name: ctx.operon.log_size
features.description: log(1 + number of genes in the protein's operon); 0 if not a member

features.name: ctx.operon.n_members_with_seq_support
features.description: other operon members with any baseline sequence claim of any function

features.name: ctx.operon.n_members_dark
features.description: other operon members with no claim at all

features.name: ctx.layout.available
features.description: 1 if gene coordinates (state.genomeLayout) are available

features.name: ctx.layout.n_neighbors_10kb
features.description: other genes within +-10 kb (midpoint) on the same contig

features.name: ctx.layout.same_strand_fraction
features.description: fraction of those neighbours on the candidate's strand (0 if none)

features.name: ctx.competitor.max_raw
features.description: strongest raw baseline score for the SAME function on another local protein (same operon or +-10 kb); paralog/decoy signal

features.name: ctx.competitor.n_with_claim
features.description: number of other local proteins with any claim for the same function

features.name: ctx.gap.available
features.description: 1 if metabolic gaps were supplied (state.metabolicGaps non-empty)

features.name: ctx.gap.function_listed
features.description: 1 if an open (not already closed) metabolic gap lists this EC/GO function; a listing indicator, NOT a Bayes factor

features.name: ctx.gap.gapseq_guessed_listed
features.description: 1 if such a gap was one for which gapseq itself proposed a gene (a different, weaker kind of listing)

features.name: ctx.nbr.available
features.description: 1 if structured neighbourhood features were supplied for this candidate

features.name: ctx.nbr.support_max
features.description: supplied: strongest raw baseline support among neighbours for functions in the candidate's reaction/pathway neighbourhood

features.name: ctx.nbr.n_supporting
features.description: supplied: number of neighbours with such support

features.name: ctx.nbr.conflict_max
features.description: supplied: strongest raw support among neighbours for a function incompatible with the candidate (unfavourable context)

features.name: ctx.nbr.reaction_distance_available
features.description: 1 if a reaction-graph distance was supplied

features.name: ctx.nbr.reaction_distance
features.description: supplied: reaction-graph distance to the nearest supported neighbour reaction (0 if unavailable)

features.name: cohort.available
features.description: 1 if cohort recurrence was supplied for this candidate

features.name: cohort.log_n_genomes
features.description: log(1 + genomes in the cohort); a count, never normalised to certainty

features.name: cohort.frac_with_orthogroup
features.description: fraction of cohort genomes with the candidate's orthogroup (0 if unavailable)

features.name: cohort.frac_with_function_seq
features.description: fraction of those with baseline sequence support for the function (not posteriors)

features.name: cohort.frac_with_context
features.description: fraction of those where the function is also supported by neighbourhood context

features.name: cohort.n_genomes_incomplete
features.description: supplied count of cohort genomes with incomplete assembly (absence uninformative)

features.name: asm.available
features.description: 1 if the genome, the protein's contig sequence and valid CDS coordinates are available; the four asm.* values below are 0 otherwise

features.name: asm.log_contig_length
features.description: log(1 + length) of the protein's contig

features.name: asm.log_distance_to_contig_end
features.description: log(1 + bp from the CDS to the nearest contig end); small = truncation risk

features.name: asm.n_contigs
features.description: log(1 + number of contigs): fragmentation

features.name: asm.log_n50
features.description: log(1 + N50) of the assembly

features.name: asm.completeness_available
features.description: 1 if an external completeness estimate (e.g. CheckM2) was supplied

features.name: asm.completeness
features.description: supplied completeness / 100 (0 if unavailable)

features.name: fba.available
features.description: 1 if conditional FBA features were supplied and usable for this candidate

features.name: fba.suppressed_objective_forced
features.description: 1 if the tested objective itself required the candidate, so its FBA values were NOT used as evidence

features.name: fba.n_conditions
features.description: log(1 + number of media/objective conditions tested)

features.name: fba.required_fraction
features.description: fraction of tested conditions in which the candidate's reaction carried flux (conditional on those conditions)

features.name: fba.knockout_growth_effect
features.description: supplied relative growth change on knockout (conditional; sign preserved)
